## Dates {#deadlines}

{{< include _dates.qmd >}}

Assignment dates are those given on each assignment. The three quizzes were held in the exam 1, 2 and 3 slots.

## Grading {#grading}

Everything is out of **100 marks**. The scheme below was published at the start of the course as provisional.

```{=html}
<table class="t" data-quarto-disable-processing="true">
<thead><tr><th>Component</th><th>Marks</th><th>How</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><th>Quizzes</th><td class="big">36</td><td>Three quizzes of 12 marks each, held in the exam 1, 2 and 3 slots.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Assignments</th><td class="big">32</td><td>Four group assignments of about 8 marks each, each followed by a viva. You get one week for each.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Project</th><td class="big">27</td><td>A group project: a first presentation (10), a final presentation (12) and a final report (5).</td></tr>
<tr><th>Interactive article</th><td class="big">5</td><td>A Streamlit app or similar interactive article that explains a concept.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Total</th><td class="big">100</td><td></td></tr>
</tbody></table>
```

### Assignment marks {#assignment-marks}

```{=html}
<table class="t att" style="max-width:340px" data-quarto-disable-processing="true">
<thead><tr><th>Part</th><th>Share</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>Correctness of the code</td><td>50%</td></tr><tr><td>Code quality</td><td>25%</td></tr><tr><td>Presentation and conceptual understanding</td><td>25%</td></tr></tbody></table>
```

There are at most 20 assignment groups in the course, of two or three students depending on class size.

### Project {#project}

There are at most 10 project groups, of three to five students depending on class size.

